# Stewart Kyasimire

Stewart Kyasimire is a Glasgow-based filmmaker, director, executive producer, and cinematographer. He is the founder of the production company Create Anything, established in 2019. He directed the BBC Scotland documentary Black and Scottish and serving as series director of the Amazon Prime Video documentary series Four Kings. He received a nomination for the British Academy Scotland Awards for Director – Factual.
Early life and career
Kyasimire began his professional career as a user experience (UX) designer before transitioning into filmmaking in the late 2010s. His early projects included short films, music videos, and commercial productions, through which he developed experience in documentary and factual storytelling.
In 2019, he founded the Glasgow-based production company, Create Anything.
In 2022, Kyasimire worked alongside directors Manu Kurewa, Eubha Akilade, and Morayo Akande on the production of The Wedding, with a British actor Colin Salmon collaborating with him to develop the concept and help create the initial characters for the series.
Production companies
Create Anything
Create Anything is an independent production company based in Glasgow. The company develops documentary and factual programming for television and streaming platforms. Kyasimire serves as managing director and executive producer of the company. In April 2024, the company signed a two-year development deal with Banijay UK covering scripted and unscripted projects.
re:frame
Kyasimire launched re:frame, a professional network intended to support underrepresented filmmakers and crew members in the United Kingdom film and television industries. The initiative connects production companies with a database of creative and technical professionals.
Selected works
Black and Scottish (2019)
Black and Scottish is a 30-minute documentary broadcast on BBC Scotland and produced by Tern TV. The film examines the identities and experiences of Black people in Scotland through interviews with contributors from media, politics, science, and the arts.
Kyasimire received a nomination at the BAFTA Scotland Awards in the category of Director – Factual for his work on the film.
Four Kings (2024)
Four Kings is a four-part documentary series released on Amazon Prime Video. The series examines the careers and rivalries of British boxers Frank Bruno, Nigel Benn, Chris Eubank, and Lennox Lewis.
Recognition
Kyasimire was nominated for the British Academy Scotland Awards for Director – Factual.
